column1: # Game profile of Dark Souls Remastered (Switch, update 1.0.3 = v196608). In bring-up
# FromSoftware engine, SDK 4, NVN; modules main + subsdk0 + sdk.
# RomFS: dvdbnd*.bhd5/.bdt BHD5 archives; shaders are GLSLC outputs inside DCX/BND3 entries.
# SDK 4: the shared-font address points at the TTF itself
# SDK 4: the game wants NVN API 53
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# ---- NVN driver constant segments (Mario's values, the translator's built-in layout, unless the engine says otherwise) ----
# main holds 72 GLSLC outputs and the RomFS has no BNSH / BAHS / UnityFS: the shaders are compiled into main (13 Sentinels, the KTGL games)
# with shader_main_glslc: single-stage programs combined per draw (every GLSLC output in main seen so far is one stage)
# DS1R: about 3,000 GLSLC outputs live in BND3 archives inside the DCX/BHD5 data (extracted with dsr_glslc.py into glslc_capture)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB)
